inlines.v: THIRTEENTH, adjective thur'teenth. [supra.] The third after the tenth; the ordinal of thirteen; as the thirteenth day of the month. THIRTEENTH, noun thur'teenth. In music, an interval forming the octave of the sixth, or sixth of the octave.
